rules.question: How is a table's header row drawn one header at a time, so a header can show a tooltip?
rules.decision: D115 B1-4 review (code-only fold of the Stars tab's header loop onto the report window's)

owner_lines.why: the header row, in the owner

rules.note: A table whose headers carry no tooltip calls ImGui::TableHeadersRow() and is not flagged. A table that needs a tooltip on a header calls the owner and passes the tooltip in its after_header callback.
